test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The difference between the simple interest and the compound interest, compounded annually, on a certain sum of money for 2 years at 17% per annum is ₹967. Find the sum [rounded off to the nearest integer].
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For 2 years, **Difference (D)** = P × (R/100)²

967 = P × (17/100) × (17/100)

P = (967 × 10000) ÷ 289

P = 33460.20... ≈ ₹33,460

**∴ The correct answer is ₹33,460.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Rate of Interest (R)** = 17% | **Time (T)** = 2 years | **Difference (D)** = ₹967

**Formula Used:**

Difference (D) = CI − SI for 2 years = P × (R/100)²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9990a5c7ed884b3410e1a0a862e5a56a5bbe20da92c9ed1626cad9db5b7d99b9.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ D = P × (R/100)²

⇒ 967 = P × (17/100)²

⇒ 967 = P × (289/10000)

⇒ P = (967 × 10000) ÷ 289

⇒ P = 9670000 ÷ 289

⇒ P = 33460.2076...

⇒ Rounding off to the nearest integer, **Principal (P)** ≈ ₹33,460

**∴ The correct answer is ₹33,460.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Difference for 2 Years

The difference between CI and SI for 2 years is given by the formula D = P × (R/100)².

Difference for 3 Years

The difference between CI and SI for 3 years is given by D = P × (R/100)² × (3 + R/100).

Effective Rate Method

Effective SI rate for 2 years = 2R%. Effective CI rate for 2 years = (2R + R²/100)%. The difference is R²/100% of Principal.
